requirements.rule: beta/current and CURRENT_STATE must identify the newest public LIVE Beta; an older release must never overwrite a newer current state

preserve authenticated session across app version updates; SUPERADMIN has exactly two login credential methods: a 1..20 character string containing server-current HHmm within +/-5 minutes with no device trust/binding, or an 8-digit single-use email OTP; successful OTP use sends the next OTP; time login does not rotate OTP; legacy/static SUPERADMIN password login is disabled; no plaintext credential secret is stored in public GitHub
owner checklist and acceptance state are repository-backed, monotonic and fenced by release/checklist revision so an older Beta state cannot overwrite a newer current state
